$description: Amber Paper theme (DMNC-1591): reverse-video amber monochrome. Amber is the page ground; everything that is amber in the default (text, borders, fills) flips to black/near-black ink. A third theme next to the dark default and `light`, never a replacement for light. Like the cga-mode4/5 themes it remaps the CGA primitives inside its own selector, so component CSS that reads raw `--color-cga-*` vars flips too. Functional colour stays monochrome (dark-brown/black ink + pattern fills), never honest red/green (DMNC-922). No phosphor bloom on reverse video: glow colours are transparent.

cga.$description: Reverse-video primitive remap (theme-scoped). Ground and ink swap: black to amber, amber to black; the dim/gray ramp becomes dark-brown ink readable on amber.

black.$description: Reverse video: the darkest CGA value becomes the amber ground.

darkGray.$description: Reverse video: raised/secondary surface, a slightly darker amber shade.

amber.$description: Reverse video: amber ink becomes near-black.

amberBright.$description: Reverse video: hover/active peaks go darker, not lighter.

amberDim.$description: Reverse video: dim amber becomes mid brown (4.3:1 on ground, 3.5:1 on shade).

amberGlow.$description: Reverse video has no phosphor bloom: transparent, so raw amber-glow rules render nothing.

yellow.$description: Reverse video: accent yellow becomes ink.

lightGray.$description: Reverse video: tan body tone becomes dark brown (5.8:1 on ground).

white.$description: Reverse video: hover/emphasis tone becomes a deep brown.

tertiary.$description: Third surface level (same as secondary, mirrors the default).

accent.$description: Accent fill: what was an amber fill is black ink. Pair with text.onAccent (amber).

brand.$description: Brand fill (e.g. primary button), black. Pair with text.onBrand.

brandBright.$description: Brand emphasis fill (hover/active), deep brown, visibly distinct from the black brand fill.

brandDim.$description: Dim brand fill (card header, timeline axis), dark brown; text.onAccent (amber) reads 5.8:1 on it.

error.$description: Destructive fill stays monochrome: dark brown with text.white (amber) on it.

success.$description: Success fill stays monochrome: deep brown with text.white (amber) on it.

primary.$description: Black ink body text (11.4:1 on ground).

secondary.$description: DMNC-1494: visible de-emphasised tone on the amber ground (5.8:1). For text on a black fill use text.onAccent.

onAccent.$description: DMNC-1494: text/icon on an accent (black) fill, amber.

disabled.$description: Disabled text/icon, mid brown, at least 3:1 on ground and shade.

muted.$description: Muted supplementary text, dark brown (5.8:1 ground, 4.7:1 shade).

brandBright.$description: Brand emphasis text (hover/active peaks), near-black; reverse video peaks go darker.

onBrand.$description: Text/icon on a black brand fill, amber.

error.$description: Monochrome error text, ink (pair with icon/pattern, never colour alone).

white.$description: Light foreground for functional (dark) fills; in reverse video the light tone is the amber ground.

brandDim.$description: Dim brand border, mid brown (3:1+ on ground).

default.$description: Link, deep brown (9.6:1); distinguished by underline, not hue.

info.$description: Alert surface, amber shade; tone is carried by icon + text, not hue.

error.$description: No bloom on reverse video, transparent.

glowXs.$description: No phosphor bloom on reverse video (transparent).

glowSm.$description: No phosphor bloom on reverse video (transparent).

glowMd.$description: No phosphor bloom on reverse video (transparent).

glowLg.$description: No phosphor bloom on reverse video (transparent).

color.$description: Focus ring, ink on the amber ground.

overlay.$description: Modal backdrop, ink at 70% so the amber dialog separates from the page.

vignetteGlow.$description: No inner glow on reverse video.

vignetteEdge.$description: Vignette edge darkening, ink at low alpha.

vignetteCorner.$description: Vignette corner darkening, ink at low alpha.

phosphorGlow.$description: No phosphor bloom on reverse video.
